fix(runtime): enforce runtime profile isolation

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-61
  description: |-
    Launch Grok from the sealed command arguments so native agent profiles reach the child process.
    
    Preflight Cursor and Grok runtime profiles with their isolated provider environments, retain sanitized evidence and failure classifications, and fence sealed executable paths and Cursor endpoint values.
    
    Move legacy unsealed operations into explicit recovery and restore per-profile active operation counts from durable bindings during bootstrap.
